item.title: Focuset 0.11.1
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.1 fixes automatic updates.

  • Fixed:** 0.11.0 could not reach its update feed. From 0.11.1 on, Focuset finds new versions by itself again.

item.title: Focuset 0.11.0
item.description:
Focuset 0.11.0 is the first public release.

  • Updates by themselves.** Focuset checks once a day and asks before installing a new version.
  • Focus follows click.** The window you click stays sharp and everything else softens. Turn it on in the menu bar under Quick toggles.
  • Quiet and Spotlight.** Quiet blurs everything around your window. Spotlight keeps a soft light around it and fades the rest.
  • Quick toggles** in the menu bar: Follow click, Hide Dock, Center window, Grayscale, Grain and Glow.
  • Always sharp apps.** Color pickers, launchers or music players never blur and never interrupt your focus.
  • Appear effects:** Instant, Fade, Bloom and Ripple.
  • Grain strength** from 0 to 100 %.
  • Displays:** keep one window sharp across all displays, or the last clicked window on each display.
  • Fixed: the Dock no longer jerks in and out with auto-hide, and Mission Control is no longer closed by Focuset.
